An '''electrum dolabra''' is a [[dolabra]] of the [[Electrum equipment|electrum]] tier, made by smithing a diamond axe with [[electrum alloy]] and a [[smithing upgrade template]]. It combines a pickaxe and axe with Fortune III.

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

This upgrade needs a [[smithing upgrade template]]; without one, the same diamond axe and alloy make an [[electrum axe]]. Because recipes match by item ID, a diamond dolabra works as the base as well.

== Usage ==

=== Mining ===
It breaks pickaxe and axe blocks at speed 10 and obsidian, crying obsidian and ender chests at speed 55, with 3000 durability. Unlike the [[electrum axe]], it has no weapon intrinsics.

Matcha Flavoured adds beds, candles, cacti and honeycomb blocks to the blocks that axes break quickly.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/axe.json}}</ref>

=== Intrinsics ===
The electrum fortune intrinsic ({{G|Fortune}}) works like [[Fortune]] on ores, crops and leaves; the pack's loot tables check for it directly. Electrum tools are the only source of Fortune III in the pack, and the intrinsic cannot be combined with Fortune or Silk Touch.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/enchantment/electrum_tool.json}}</ref> In 1.12.2 it gives no bonus on stone [[Native Gold|native gold]] (the gold ore block), whose loot table applies Fortune twice instead of Fortune and the electrum intrinsic; deepslate native gold works normally.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/gold_ore.json}}</ref> Intrinsics are stored on the item and applied as enchantments when it enters a player's inventory.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/apply_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

In 1.12.2 the language file has no name for this intrinsic, so the tooltip shows its translation key, "enchantment.kleispack.electrum_tool III", in yellow instead of the {{G|Fortune}} glyph.<ref>{{Source|MF_resourcepack/assets/minecraft/lang/en_us.json}}</ref> This does not change how it works.

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Hp|6}} damage at an attack speed of 1.2.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with {{MCW|Block of Diamond|blocks of diamond}}. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting ingredient ===
In a [[blast furnace]] it melts down into an [[adamant alloy]], not electrum, because electrum shares the netherite item IDs. This makes melting electrum gear a way to turn an [[electrum alloy]] into an adamant alloy.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blast/netherite_ingot_from_blasting_netherite_materials.json}}</ref>

=== Trading ===
{{Uses}}

An apprentice [[weaponsmith]] buys it for one [[electrum alloy]], so the alloy can be reused.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/weaponsmith/2/electrum_dolabra.json}}</ref>

== Notes ==
* It uses a netherite item ID, so it does not burn in fire or lava.

== History ==

{{History line|1.10|Electrum was buffed. A [[weaponsmith]] now takes the item back in exchange for its alloy, so players can rebuild it with updated stats.}}
{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|The upgrade now keeps the base item's enchantments. Added the "Repaired with" tooltip. Can only be repaired with blocks of diamond. Electrum became the only source of Fortune III.}}
{{History line|1.12.2|No longer burns in fire or lava. Warding was removed from electrum tools so that they focus on Fortune. Dolabras began to shift from weapon hybrids to pure axe and pickaxe tools; the release notes say their damage and weapon intrinsics will be reduced over time.}}
